title: Riso Lane DESKTOP — Electron and Tauri scaffolds

questions.prompt: When this lane runs under /goal, what should it prioritize first?
questions.description: Repo already has electron-vite + tauri templates gated on desktop_* answers. electron-forge is a Copier choice with no scaffold tree. Prefer a clear default execution posture.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Baseline health: audit electron/ + tauri/ gates against existing desktop_* enums, fix in-tree correctness, validate electron-app and tauri-app answers; emit COORD handoffs for contract/structure gaps (forge, exclusion path shape, non-enum features).

questions.prompt: How should this lane treat the electron-forge gap?
questions.description: copier.yml offers desktop_framework=electron-forge and excludes electron/electron-forge/, but template/files/electron/** is a flat electron-vite tree (no electron-forge/ subdirectory). Implementing forge may also need COORD exclusion-path fixes.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Do not invent forge under wrong paths in this pass. Document the gap, keep electron-vite correct, and emit a COORD handoff for exclusion path shape + forge contract before any forge scaffold lands.

options.label: Handoff then scaffold if COORD agrees

questions.prompt: How should non-enum desktop feature gates in Tauri be handled?
questions.description: copier desktop_features enums are auto_updater, tray_icon, custom_titlebar. Some tauri templates also gate system_info and menu, which are not in the Copier enum. DESKTOP must not invent new answer keys.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Align template gates to the existing enum only where safe; emit COORD handoff for system_info/menu (add to contract or remove). Do not invent new Copier keys in this lane.

questions.prompt: What verification is required before calling the lane done?
questions.description: Avoid hand-editing samples/*/render/. Prefer answers validation + jinja syntax; full sample render is heavier and PLATFORM-owned for answers files.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Validate electron-app and tauri-app answers JSON; run validate_jinja_templates.py when available; do not hand-edit samples/*/render/.
